title: Find Leads
summary: For founders and small teams who sell to businesses: describe your customer in one sentence, approve one maximum price, and your agent returns a CRM-ready list of decision-makers whose work emails were checked the same day.
outcome: Describe your customer; get 25 decision-makers with verified work emails and why each company fits.
boundary: It finds and checks contacts only. It does not send email, add anyone to your CRM or a sequence, guess addresses or spend more than the maximum you approve. Why a company fits comes from its company data and website; it does not show that the company wants to buy now.

catalog_tools.purpose: Find up to 100 companies that match the customer description in one search.
Industry, staff count, location and description for the fit check and the why-it-matched line.
People route 1: people at the company by job title, with their work email and the pages where they were found.
People route 2: up to 20 people at the company with their titles; the agent keeps only matching titles.
People route 3: one person by job title, used only while the provider answers.
Confirm a person's current role when the newest evidence is over a year old or sources disagree.
Work email for a person found on route 2 or 3, from their profile URL or name and company domain.
Second email lookup, used once when the first finds nothing.
Check each email the same day it is found: verified, catch-all or not ready.

inputs: Who you sell to, in one sentence, for example "UK accounting firms with 10 to 50 staff"
Job titles (default: Founder or CEO at companies of up to 50 staff, otherwise the Head or VP of the team that would use what you sell)
How many contacts: 10, 25, 50 or 100 (default 25, one per company)
Optional: a CSV of customers or contacts to leave out
outputs: A summary line such as "23 of 25 ready · 19 verified · 4 catch-all · $1.41 · 9 min"
A table of contacts with a one-line reason each company fits
A CRM-ready CSV: name, title, company, website, why it matched, industry, size, city, country, email, email status, date checked and source
What could not be found and why, with a priced retry, and an offer to research the top 10 with Research My Accounts
Details at the end: how the list was built and every paid call with its run ID and cost

cost.model: You approve one maximum and pay only for calls that complete. Up to 4 company searches, company data for up to two companies per contact, then for each company one people search, up to two email lookups and one email check, plus a role check for at most one contact in five. Refused calls are not charged.
cost.notes: Prices inspected 14 Oct 2026: company search $0.0025; company data $0.0067; Hunter people search $0.0335 for up to 10 people (billed per 10 results; $0.335 is the listed price for 100); LeadMagic list of 20 people $0.035; Findymail title search $0.0278 per person; role check $0.0098; email lookup $0.0068, second lookup $0.035; email check $0.0025. One contact costs at most $0.0793. Maximum: 10 contacts $0.96 (the trial), 25 contacts $2.38, 50 contacts $4.75, 100 contacts $9.48. Most runs cost far less because the first people route returns the email with the person. The Skill inspects prices again before every quote.

approvals: Approve one maximum price before the first paid call
Approve again before anything that would go over it, including a retry of companies that failed
Nothing is sent and nothing is added to your CRM
compatibility: One Scrollport connection that can search, inspect and run tools and read the wallet
Somewhere to save the CSV and a small progress file, so a later run can skip people you already have
